# Job Up (jobup.ge)

> Job Up's AI searches the whole internet for job vacancies in Georgia ("სამსახურის ძებნის ჭკვიანი გზა"), so job seekers don't need to know where a job was posted. Describe the job you want or upload a CV: the AI finds the vacancies that fit and sends new matches via Telegram or email. Employers use the same AI to search and shortlist candidates.

Language: Georgian (ka). Coverage: Georgia (Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, Rustavi and other cities, plus remote and abroad roles).

## Main pages
- [AI job search](https://jobup.ge/home): describe the job you want or upload a CV, and the AI finds matching vacancies. Filters for city, category, salary and work type.
- [For employers](https://jobup.ge/employers): AI candidate search and shortlisting.
- [About Job Up](https://jobup.ge/about)

## Searches
The search takes its filters from the address: `https://jobup.ge/home?location=<city>&search=<words>`, for example [jobs in Tbilisi](https://jobup.ge/home?location=%E1%83%97%E1%83%91%E1%83%98%E1%83%9A%E1%83%98%E1%83%A1%E1%83%98). Each vacancy opens over the search at `https://jobup.ge/home?job=<id>`, with a link to apply on the original source.
